project.name: rag-notebook
project.description: 基于Next.js的RAG（检索增强生成）应用，提供AI聊天、知识库管理、文档解析、笔记记录和用户认证功能，使用Prisma ORM配合PostgreSQL与pgvector实现语义搜索 (Next.js RAG application with AI-powered chat, knowledge base management, document parsing, note-taking, and user authentication using Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL + pgvector for semantic search)

tour.title: 项目概览 (Project Overview)
tour.description: 从这里开始了解项目目的和结构。这是一个基于Next.js的RAG（检索增强生成）应用，提供AI聊天、知识库管理和笔记功能 (Start here to understand the project purpose and structure — a Next.js RAG app with AI chat, knowledge base, and note-taking)

tour.title: 架构与设计 (Architecture & Design)
tour.description: 查看API设计和实施计划，了解应用架构、数据流和关键设计决策 (Review API design and implementation plan for application architecture, data flow, and key design decisions)

tour.title: 应用入口点 (Application Entry Point)
tour.description: Next.js应用从根布局开始，设置提供者（主题、会话、通知）和全局样式。首页将认证用户重定向到仪表盘 (The app starts from root layout with Theme/Session/Toaster providers; landing page redirects authenticated users to dashboard)

tour.title: 项目配置 (Project Configuration)
tour.description: 核心项目配置文件：TypeScript、Next.js、PostCSS、Tailwind CSS、ESLint和环境变量 (Core project configuration: TypeScript, Next.js, PostCSS, Tailwind, ESLint, and environment variables)

tour.title: 认证系统 (Authentication System)
tour.description: 用户认证由NextAuth.js处理，中间件保护登录/注册页面，认证布局提供共享居中设计 (Authentication via NextAuth.js with login/register pages protected by middleware and shared centered auth layout)

tour.title: 主应用布局与导航 (Main Application Layout & Navigation)
tour.description: 主应用布局提供核心导航结构：侧边栏、页眉、移动端导航和主题切换，作为所有认证页面的外壳 (Main layout provides core navigation with sidebar, header, mobile nav, and theme toggle — the shell for authenticated pages)

tour.title: 仪表盘 (Dashboard)
tour.description: 仪表盘提供应用概览，包括统计数据展示和快捷操作入口 (Dashboard provides an overview with statistics and quick action entries)

tour.title: AI聊天界面 (AI Chat Interface)
tour.description: 聊天功能是核心RAG交互界面，用户提问后可获取AI生成回答及知识库来源引用 (Core RAG-powered chat interface for questions with AI-generated responses and knowledge base source references)

tour.title: 知识库 (Knowledge Base)
tour.description: 知识库支持文档上传、查看和管理，文档经解析、分块和向量化后用于RAG检索 (Upload, view, and manage documents — parsed, chunked, and vectorized for RAG semantic search)

tour.title: 笔记与回收站 (Notes & Trash)
tour.description: 笔记功能基于Milkdown编辑器提供富文本编辑，回收站管理软删除项目 (Rich text note editing with Milkdown editor; trash manages soft-deleted items)

tour.title: API路由 - 认证 (API Routes - Authentication)
tour.description: 认证API处理器：NextAuth回调和用户注册 (API handlers for authentication: NextAuth callback and user registration)

tour.title: API路由 - 聊天 (API Routes - Chat)
tour.description: 聊天API处理器：消息流式传输和会话管理 (API handlers for chat: message streaming and session management)

tour.title: API路由 - 知识库 (API Routes - Knowledge Base)
tour.description: 知识库API处理器：文档CRUD操作和上传解析 (API handlers for knowledge base: CRUD operations and document upload/parsing)

tour.title: API路由 - 笔记与回收站 (API Routes - Notes & Trash)
tour.description: 笔记与回收站API处理器：笔记CRUD和回收站管理 (API handlers for notes CRUD and trash management)

tour.title: API路由 - 仪表盘 (API Routes - Dashboard)
tour.description: 仪表盘API处理器：统计数据和聚合信息 (API handler for dashboard statistics and aggregate data)

tour.title: 数据库模式 (Database Schema)
tour.description: Prisma模式定义了数据模型：用户、聊天会话、聊天消息、知识库文档、知识分块和笔记；pgvector扩展支持语义向量搜索 (Prisma schema: User, ChatSession, ChatMessage, KnowledgeDocument, KnowledgeChunk, Note models with pgvector for semantic search)

tour.title: AI与RAG库 (AI & RAG Library)
tour.description: 核心AI集成层：Dashscope API、文本嵌入生成、带重排序的语义搜索、文档解析（PDF/DOCX）、文本分块策略和向量存储 (Core AI layer: Dashscope API, embeddings, semantic search with reranking, document parsing, chunking, and vector storage)

tour.title: 核心工具与数据库客户端 (Core Utilities & Database Client)
tour.description: 共享工具：数据库连接管理、Prisma客户端配置、API辅助函数、认证辅助和移动端检测Hook (Shared utilities: DB connection, Prisma client config, API helpers, auth helpers, and mobile detection hook)

tour.title: UI组件库 (UI Component Library)
tour.description: 全面的shadcn/ui原语集：侧边栏、对话框、下拉菜单、选择器、滑出面板、标签页、工具提示、卡片、按钮、输入框、徽章、头像等 (Comprehensive shadcn/ui primitives powering the UI)

tour.title: 基础设施与部署 (Infrastructure & Deployment)
tour.description: 部署应用栈的Docker Compose配置 (Docker Compose configuration for deploying the application stack)
